Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001085": The duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 were caused by a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys.  (about: webhooks, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1001081": During incident INC-2026-003, the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20.  (about: webhooks, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000907": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team flagged the job scheduler's cold start regression because the job scheduler is not their service.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000904": On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000773" [decision]: As of 2025-10-07, reindex jobs will page on failure.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000771": In INC-2025-023, the indexer served stale results for two days starting 2025-10-03 because a reindex job failed silently on a full disk.  (about: indexer)
- memory_id "1000750" [decision]: As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000722" [decision]: The job scheduler was owned by the Dune team from 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team, until ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000716" [decision]: As of 2025-09-05, the Dune team still owned the job scheduler; ownership transferred to Cinder on 2025-09-23.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000712": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings Cinder instead of the Dune team.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000644" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot is retired.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000616" [decision]: Following the INC-2025-017 review, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000614": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000610": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000456": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000439": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000165": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
Existing entity names: webhooks, INC-2026-003, Boreal team, job scheduler, indexer, ledger service, the bus, reporting service, Cinder, Dune team, Ember team, authentication gateway, INC-2025-017, INC-2025-011, feature-flags, INC-2025-004, notifier

The note:

[2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
